decisions.decision: frontend/convex/ is version-controlled; only convex/_generated/ is ignored
decisions.rationale: The blanket ignore meant schema/auth/http/auth.config were never committed — half of 01-02's deliverable had no history or rollback. User-selected. Commit feea71f.

decisions.decision: Convex Auth JWT keys generated with the jose script, not openssl
decisions.rationale: openssl output is not the format Convex Auth expects; a mismatch fails silently at session issuance.

decisions.decision: Never safeParse(import.meta.env) directly — narrow through pickPublicEnv()
decisions.rationale: Vite injects MODE/DEV/PROD/BASE_URL/SSR; z.strictObject rejects them, so validation failed on every environment and blanked the app.

decisions.decision: Exactly one router: createBrowserRouter + RouterProvider in App; main.tsx adds no BrowserRouter
decisions.rationale: A data router provides its own <Router>; nesting two throws at mount.
It is the only test rendering the real main.tsx tree without mocking the router or auth layer. Both blank-page bugs would fail it.

decisions.decision: Teal #0F5C56 / canvas #F7F4EE, system-first fonts, restrained motion
decisions.rationale: Locked in 01-UI-SPEC.md. Fonts and motion constraints apply to ALL phases, not just Phase 1.

next_action: Settle the Phase 5 aesthetic target, then /gsd-plan-phase 2. Optionally walk the 4 open Task-4 browser items first to close Phase 1 properly.
context_notes: Phase 1 is delivered and the app runs. Two blank-page bugs shipped in the same phase that reported 74/74 passing tests, both in the one composition no test rendered: AuthProvider over App over the real router. The fix plus structural mitigations (ErrorBoundary, app.composition.test.tsx, env.test.ts, jsdom url in vitest.config) are committed. Generalisable lesson: when every suite mocks the same layer, that layer is untested regardless of test count — and that pattern repeats whenever an executor mocks around a boundary instead of rendering through it. The user is design-sensitive and flagged the UI as too basic; the honest answer is that Phase 5 changes the landing substantially but fonts/motion are locked for all phases. That is a live decision, not a settled one. The user is executing Phases 2-5 later.
